999008199.text: はぁっ！
くっ！

（果ての大陸への鍵となる「九偉人図」。
　９枚のうち５枚を手に入れることができた）

localizations.en: (The Portraits of the Nine—the key to reaching World's End. We managed to secure five out of nine.)

999008199.text:
（でもその途中、私の兄と姉にあたる九偉人
　ヘルトとゼロが立ちはだかった）

localizations.en: (But along the way, two of the Nine who are like siblings to me—Held and Zero—stood in our path.)

999008199.text:
どうした妹？　俺らに勝って２枚の「九偉人図」を
手に入れるのではなかったのか？

localizations.en: What's wrong, little sister? Weren't you going to beat us and claim the two Portraits?

999008199.text:
もちろん手に入れるさね、
ヘル兄たちの強制的な「管理」を止めるためにも！

localizations.en: Oh, we're claiming them alright—we have to, if we're going to put a stop to your forced 'management'!

999008199.text:
（二人が決戦に指定してきたのはここ、
　人の住めない無人島、雷鳴の島だった）

localizations.en: (The two of them chose this place for our showdown—Thundering Isle, an uninhabited island no one can live on.)

999008199.text:
打ち込んでこいよ。
石となった仲間が砕けてもいいのならな

localizations.en: Come at me then. That is, if you don't mind your petrified friends shattering.

999008199.text: レスナ……！　まったく、揺さぶってくれるわね

localizations.en: Resna...! Always pressing every button, aren't you.

999008199.text:
（でも、二人の罠にはまってレスナたちは
　石化してしまった……）

localizations.en: (But we fell right into their trap, and Resna and the others were turned to stone...)

999008199.text:
大丈夫、ヴァレリア。今にハイディたちが
石化を解く薬を持ってきてくれるよ

localizations.en: Don't worry, Valeria. Heidi and the others will bring back an antidote before you know it.

999008199.text:
ふん、減らず口を。
お前たちが音を上げるのが先だろう？

localizations.en: Hmph. Big talk. You'll be begging for mercy long before that.

999008199.text:
従順になるまで徹底的に教育し
兄弟の序列を叩き込んでやるぞ

localizations.en: I'll drill the sibling hierarchy into you until you learn some obedience.

999008199.text:
力で従わせてくるお兄ちゃんなんて、
誰も望んでないわよ！

localizations.en: Nobody asked for a big brother who rules through force!

999008199.text:
石化能力を持つ危険な魔物を「管理」せず
この島に持ち込んでの私的利用……

localizations.en: Bringing a dangerous creature with petrifying abilities to this island for personal use, with no regard for 'management'...

999008199.text:
たとえ兄といえども不届き千万さ！
そうだろ？　シトリン！　言ってやりなシトリン！

localizations.en: Brother or not, that's absolutely inexcusable! Right, Citrine? Back me up here!

999008199.text:
そ、そんなの知らないよ！
僕のほうに注意を向けさせないでほしいな

localizations.en: D-Don't ask me! And please stop pointing his attention my way!

999008199.text:
シトリン、お前が俺に攻撃してきたことは
忘れないぞ。言い訳は聞かないからな

localizations.en: Citrine. I haven't forgotten that you attacked me. Don't even think about making excuses.

999008199.text: はぁぁぁ、もう。イェルカ、恨むよ

localizations.en: Ugh, great. I'm blaming you for this, Jelka.

999008199.text:
逃げられないんだったら、
後悔のない一撃、お見舞いしてやる！

localizations.en: If there's no way out, then I'm at least going to land one hit I won't regret!

999008199.text: ヴァレリア姉ちゃん！

キューンにヤドヴィガ！？
待っててって言ったのに！

localizations.en: Quinn? Jadwiga?! I told you to stay back!

999008199.text:
私たちに兄上たちの相手は荷が重い……
その判断は正しい……けれど

localizations.en: It is correct that we lack the strength to face the elder siblings directly... However.

999008199.text:
我が主の指示は不穏分子の「管理」。
魔物の私的利用は本来の職務から逸脱しています

localizations.en: Our master's directive is to 'manage' elements of discord. Using a creature for personal ends falls outside the bounds of proper duty.

999008199.text:
相変わらずの真面目ぶりだ。
頭にクソが付くほどのな

localizations.en: Same old stickler as ever. Insufferably so.

999008199.text: そんな汚い言葉、使っちゃ……ダメなんだから！

localizations.en: You shouldn't... say things like that!

999008199.text:
おいおい、１対５か。いや……
これで２対５、だな

localizations.en: Hm, one against five? No, wait... Two against five now, is it.

999008199.text:
かように面白き戦いから、我を仲間外れにするとは。
兄者、意地悪じゃぞ！　我は抗議する！

localizations.en: To exclude me from such a delightful battle—brother, that is most unkind! I protest!

999008199.text:
お前なら勝手に戦の匂いを嗅ぎつけて来るだろう？
しかし、こうなるといささか惜しいな

localizations.en: I figured you'd sniff out a fight on your own. Though now that you're here, it's almost a shame.

999008199.text:
どうせならゴゥとリーベもいれば全員集合。
九偉人内の力の差を手っ取り早く見せられたのだが

localizations.en: If Gou and Liebe were here too, we'd have the full set. Would've made for a quick demonstration of the power gap within the Nine.

999008199.text:
あの二人は聡い、一見せずとも一聞で理解しよう。
長男と長女の強さというものを

localizations.en: Those two are sharp—they'd grasp it from a single telling without needing to witness it firsthand. The strength of the eldest brother and sister.

999008199.text:
……そうじゃ！　この後、倒れたヴァレリアたちを
引きずって、ゴゥとリーベに見せに行こう！

localizations.en: ...Oh! After we're done here, let's drag the fallen Valeria and the others over to show Gou and Liebe!

999008199.text:
ゼロ、見せに行くのはいいが、全員は面倒だ。
一人でいいだろう

localizations.en: Worth doing, but hauling everyone is too much trouble. One will do.

999008199.text:
おおっ、効率ってやつじゃな！　
まっこと兄者は頭が良い

localizations.en: Ohhh, efficiency! Truly, brother, your mind is sharp!

999008199.text:
まぁ、まずは全員倒してから考えればよいか。
さぁさぁ祭りじゃ祭りじゃ、派手にいくぞ

localizations.en: Well, we should finish them all off first and then decide. Come now, this is a celebration! Let's make it spectacular!

999008199.text: 舐めないで……私は絶対に負けない……

localizations.en: Don't underestimate me... I am not going to lose...

999008199.text:
ヴァレリア、お願い。
信じてる

localizations.en: Valeria, please. I believe in you.

999008199.text: レスナと、約束したから！！

localizations.en: Because I made a promise to Resna!!
